title: fix(app-shell): the Studio item title keeps visible width beside the actions slot (objectui#12897)
body:
Fixes #12897
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong (measured)

Live on objectui `main` `c83e3fe`: Studio › 界面, the `showcase_task` kanban view leaf, zh-CN, a 1010 × 900 window, the copilot slot open (300 px). The item header's title row is 422 px:

- the icon takes 32 px;
- the 视图 kind chip takes 37.7 px;
- the actions slot (`ml-auto flex shrink-0`) takes 316.9 px: 只读 · 用覆盖定制 132.3, 在「数据」中打开 136.6, ⋯ 32, and two 8 px gaps;
- three 12 px gaps take 36 px.

That sums to the whole row. The title (`STUDIO_ITEM_TITLE`: `min-w-0`, `flex-shrink: 1`) is the only piece allowed to shrink, so it went to 0 px. It did not truncate; nothing overflowed. At 1280 px (copilot 360 px) the row is 632 px and the title shows whole at 178 px.

## What changed

One rule in `StudioItemHeader`, for every item kind; there is no Interfaces special case.

- The read-only link's existing fold (`useStudioTabRowFold`, objectui#12707) now also holds in the title row. A chip that folds by that hook folds to its glyph when the room the row leaves the title, with the chip whole, is less than the title's whole text. It unfolds once the title fits beside it whole. The tab-row rule is unchanged. The header tells the hook which row it sits in through its context; no prop, slot or export was added.
- A cut title shows its whole text in its native tooltip, followed by the tooltip the pillar gives it (on Interfaces, the internal id). An uncut title's tooltip is unchanged.
- The meta slot gets `data-slot="meta"`, so the room calculation leaves it out (it only takes what the row has left, as in objectui#12611).

No change to the copilot slot, the Studio shell layout, or any pillar's call site.

## Live before / after (evidence branch, never merged)

Backend: `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` (published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.3`). Console: the Vite dev server. The browser stubs are listed in the README.

| run | title (box / text) | read-only link | actions in row |
|---|---|---|---|
| before 1010 | 0 px / 178 px | whole, 132.3 px | yes |
| after 1010 | 103.8 px / 178 px, cut, full text in tooltip | folded, 28 px | yes, all three |
| before 1280 | 178.2 px, whole | whole | yes |
| after 1280 | 178.2 px, whole | whole | yes |

- before 1010: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/38ea44ace744ddf8852d7c98d9319e17cd2b6332/docs/design/findings/12897/before-1010.png?raw=true
- after 1010: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/38ea44ace744ddf8852d7c98d9319e17cd2b6332/docs/design/findings/12897/after-1010.png?raw=true
- before 1280: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/38ea44ace744ddf8852d7c98d9319e17cd2b6332/docs/design/findings/12897/before-1280.png?raw=true
- after 1280: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/38ea44ace744ddf8852d7c98d9319e17cd2b6332/docs/design/findings/12897/after-1280.png?raw=true
- README with the stubs and the readings: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/38ea44ace744ddf8852d7c98d9319e17cd2b6332/docs/design/findings/12897/README.md

## Tests

- `e2e/studio-item-header-title-width.spec.ts`: a new describe block, "an Interfaces view leaf keeps its title beside the actions (objectui#12897)". It uses the spec's real Chromium layout with the header bundled from source. At the measured 422 px row it asserts:
  - the title is at least 64 px wide and equal to the room the row leaves it;
  - the link is folded;
  - the title's tooltip is its whole text, then the internal id;
  - every action is inside the row, and nothing overflows.

  Two controls cover a wide row and the 632 px row of a 1280 px window, which follows the rule; a third follows the row as it narrows and widens. The 7 objectui#12791 tests are unchanged and green.
- Ablation of the e2e pin: dropping the title-row context around the actions makes 3 tests fail. The main one reads "title 0px", with Open in Data and ⋯ outside the row. The restored blob equals HEAD.
- `StudioItemHeader.titleRowFold-12897.test.tsx`: a jsdom pin with stubbed geometry for the fold and the tooltip, 5 tests. The fold ablation gives 3 red; the tooltip ablation gives 2 red. Both restored to HEAD.
- Controls: the objectui#12791 api-chip pins, the objectui#12611 narrow-width pin and the objectui#12707 read-only fold pins are green. The 12707 CONTROL's assertion is unchanged; its name ("never folds, however narrow") was corrected to "does not fold by the tab row's width", since a title-row chip now folds when the title would be cut.

## Local gates (HEAD 92f50f3)

- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: 0.
- Family vitest: 10 files, 69 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` in 6 shards: 1556 files, 0 failed.
- `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:new-line-citations` and `check-changeset-presence`: all 0.
- eslint on the changed files: 0 errors. One react-refresh warning on the exported hook, also present on main.
- The geometry spec: 11 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- At 1010 px the title is cut (about 104 of 178 px) rather than whole, because only the read-only link folds. Folding "Open in Data" as well would be a call-site change in StudioDesignSurface; it is left out here as outside the claimed surface.
- How the other headers behave now:
  - **Data header:** the api-name chip still gives way before the title (objectui#12791's 200 px floor, pins green). On a read-only Data object, its read-only link in the actions slot now folds before the title would be cut.
  - **Flow header:** its read-only link stays at the tab row's end and folds by the unchanged tab-row rule (objectui#12707, pins green).
  - **Access header:** its read-only link folds by the title rule.
- The hook reads a chip's whole width once per text. In the e2e harness, which mounted before compiling its CSS, that left the link folded at a wide row; the spec now mounts the leaf cases on a styled page. This was not seen in the console, where the stylesheet loads first.
- The e2e spec ran locally with a temporary config without the webServer build; CI runs it under `pnpm test:e2e --project=chromium`.
